topic_score.why: Every player wants to know the exact moment they can start playing on launch day.

title: What time does GTA 6 ACTUALLY unlock!?
description: Rockstar has not announced an unlock time for GTA 6. Based on PlayStation Store listings, it is expected to unlock at midnight local time on November 19. Pre-load starts at midnight local time on November 12, and pre-loading does not let you play early.

lines.say: Rockstar has not announced when GTA 6 unlocks. It is only expected to unlock at midnight local time. Here's why.

beats.text: Expected to unlock at midnight local time.
beats.label: Not official

lines.say: The date is confirmed. GTA 6 launches on November 19, on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S.
The time is not. It comes from PlayStation Store listings, so it is expected to unlock at midnight local time, not promised.

beats.text: From PlayStation Store listings. Not announced by Rockstar.
beats.label: The source

lines.say: Here's the twist. Pre-load starts at midnight local time on November 12, a full week earlier.
But pre-loading does not let you play early.
So download it early and be ready the moment November 19 begins.
